description: A standalone, multi-tenant blog and content-marketing platform that takes a topic from keyword research → brief → AI-assisted writing → SEO/AEO optimization → multi-platform syndication → performance tracking → automated refresh. Designed to be reused across multiple products (Daily OK and others) by configuring a Workspace per product. Recommended stack — adjust per host project: TypeScript monorepo (pnpm workspaces); Postgres (Supabase preferred) with RLS; Deno or Node API workers; React + Vite admin UI; queue/worker via pg-boss or Redis; OpenAI/Anthropic adapters for LLM steps; pluggable adapters for keyword data (DataForSEO/Ahrefs/SEMrush), CMS targets (WordPress/Ghost/Webflow/custom REST), social platforms (X/LinkedIn/Meta/TikTok/Pinterest/Reddit), and analytics (GA4 + Search Console). Every external integration is an adapter behind an interface so the system is portable across products and providers. Each user story is independently shippable; build in priority order. Mark `passes: true` only when ALL acceptance criteria are met for the active workspace.

userStories.title: Scaffold monorepo with admin UI, API, and worker packages
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a clean monorepo so the blog system can be developed, tested, and deployed as a cohesive unit while remaining embeddable into existing projects.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm workspaces (or npm/yarn equivalent) with packages: apps/admin (React+Vite), apps/api (Deno or Node+Hono/Fastify), apps/worker (queue consumer), packages/db (schema + migrations), packages/core (domain models + adapter interfaces), packages/adapters (concrete adapters)
TypeScript strict mode across all packages; shared tsconfig base
ESLint + Prettier configured at root with consistent rules
Single `pnpm dev` boots admin + api + worker in parallel
README.md at root explains architecture, how to add a new Workspace, how to swap adapters
Dockerfile + docker-compose.yml for self-hosted deployment (Postgres + admin + api + worker)
.env.example with every required variable documented
userStories.notes: Foundation. Keep the embeddable surface small — most consumers will use only the API + worker; the admin UI is optional.

userStories.title: Define core Postgres schema with RLS and multi-tenant isolation
userStories.description: As a platform operator, I want a single database that cleanly isolates each Workspace (product) so I can host the blog system for multiple brands without leakage.
acceptanceCriteria: Tables: workspaces, users, workspace_members (role enum), brand_voices, style_guides, keyword_clusters, keywords, briefs, posts, post_revisions, assets, citations, distributions, distribution_targets, performance_metrics, refresh_queue, audit_log
Every tenant-scoped table has workspace_id with NOT NULL foreign key
RLS enabled on every tenant-scoped table; policies enforce workspace_id matches the JWT claim
Migrations live in packages/db/migrations and run on `pnpm migrate`
Seed script creates one demo workspace + admin user for local dev
Indices on hot paths: posts(workspace_id, status, published_at), keywords(workspace_id, cluster_id), distributions(post_id, platform)
userStories.notes: RLS is the keystone for safe multi-tenancy. Test policies with explicit pgTAP or integration tests.

userStories.title: Authentication, RBAC, and workspace membership
userStories.description: As a workspace owner, I want to invite collaborators with specific roles so editorial workflow respects permissions.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth via Supabase Auth (or pluggable: Clerk/Auth.js adapter behind interface)
Roles per workspace_member: owner, admin, editor, writer, reviewer, contributor, viewer
Permission matrix documented in packages/core/permissions.ts; enforced server-side on every endpoint
Invite flow: email invite → accept → workspace_member row created with chosen role
Admin UI: members page lists members, allows role change and removal (owner only)
Audit log entry on every role change, invite, removal
userStories.notes: Permission checks must be server-side; UI gating is convenience only.

userStories.title: Workspace settings: brand voice profile
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a per-workspace brand voice so every AI-generated draft matches our tone without re-prompting each time.
acceptanceCriteria: brand_voices table fields: workspace_id, name, tone (free text), banned_phrases (text[]), preferred_phrases (text[]), reading_level_target (enum: grade-6 to grade-14), persona_description, sample_corpus (text — paste-in examples), pov (first/second/third person), voice_attributes (jsonb: humor, formality, technicality on 1-5 scale)
Admin UI form to create/edit brand voice with live preview using a fixed sample paragraph rewritten in the configured voice
Brand voice ID can be attached to posts, briefs, and distribution variants
Default brand voice per workspace; multiple voices supported (e.g., 'corporate blog' vs 'founder POV')
Brand voice serializes to a system-prompt fragment used by every AI step
userStories.notes: Sample corpus is the highest-signal field — keep the textarea generous (10k chars).

userStories.title: Style guide linter (prose-level rules)
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a style guide that flags violations during writing so authors stay on-brand without manual review of every comma.
acceptanceCriteria: style_guides table per workspace: rules (jsonb array of {pattern, severity, message, replacement?})
Built-in rule packs: AP, Chicago, MLA, plain-language, inclusive-language
Custom rules: regex or substring with severity (error/warn/info)
Linter runs in editor in real time; underlines violations with hover-to-explain
Linter also runs server-side on save and blocks publish if any 'error'-severity rules fail (unless overridden by editor+ role)
userStories.notes: Use a worker-thread or web worker so linting doesn't block typing on long posts.

userStories.title: CMS adapter interface + reference WordPress and Ghost adapters
userStories.description: As a developer integrating the blog system into an existing site, I want a stable adapter interface so I can publish to whatever CMS my product uses.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/cms-adapter.ts defines: createPost, updatePost, deletePost, getPost, listPosts, uploadAsset, healthCheck
Adapters implemented: wordpress (REST API + JWT auth), ghost (Admin API + JWT), webflow (CMS API), custom-rest (configurable endpoint + auth header)
Adapter selection per workspace via cms_adapter and cms_config (encrypted) columns on workspaces
All adapters covered by a shared contract test suite that runs against a live or mocked endpoint
Markdown/HTML transform layer normalizes output for each CMS's quirks (e.g., Ghost's mobiledoc vs WP's Gutenberg blocks)
userStories.notes: Encrypt cms_config with pgcrypto or a KMS-backed key. Never log decrypted credentials.

userStories.title: Admin UI shell: navigation, layout, theming
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a consistent admin shell so the various tools feel like one product.
acceptanceCriteria: React + Vite + TanStack Router (or React Router) + TanStack Query
Layout: top bar (workspace switcher, user menu), left nav (Ideas, Briefs, Posts, Distribution, Analytics, Refresh, Settings)
Tailwind + shadcn/ui (or equivalent) for components; dark/light theme toggle
Workspace switcher persists selection per-user and reflects in every API call via header
Empty states with helpful CTAs on every section
Keyboard shortcuts: g+i (Ideas), g+b (Briefs), g+p (Posts), / (search)
userStories.notes: Don't gold-plate the UI; functional > beautiful for v1.

userStories.title: Rich-text editor with Markdown parity
userStories.description: As a writer, I want a powerful editor that round-trips between Markdown and rich text so I can paste, draft fast, and preserve structure.
acceptanceCriteria: TipTap (or Lexical) with extensions: headings, lists, blockquotes, code blocks (syntax highlighted), tables, images with alt text, links with title, footnotes, callouts/admonitions
Markdown import: paste Markdown and it converts to rich nodes
Markdown export: every post stores canonical Markdown in posts.body_markdown alongside posts.body_html
Slash-command menu (/) for inserting blocks
Inline AI toolbar: highlight text → 'rewrite shorter / expand / change tone / cite source'
Autosave to post_revisions every 10s of inactivity
userStories.notes: Markdown as source of truth simplifies migrations and avoids editor-lock-in.

userStories.title: Version history with diff and restore
userStories.description: As an editor, I want to see every revision of a post so I can recover from mistakes and review changes.
acceptanceCriteria: post_revisions table: post_id, author_id, body_markdown, title, meta_title, meta_description, created_at
Admin UI history panel shows revision list with author + timestamp
Side-by-side diff view (markdown-aware) between any two revisions
One-click restore creates a new revision rather than overwriting
Revisions retained for 90 days minimum; configurable per workspace
userStories.notes: Diff at the markdown level; HTML diffs are noisy.

userStories.title: Asset library: images, quotes, data, expert contacts
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a single place to manage reusable assets so research and visuals are findable across posts.
acceptanceCriteria: Assets table with type enum: image, quote, data_table, expert_contact, link, file
Upload to S3-compatible storage (Cloudflare R2 / Supabase Storage adapter)
Image assets: auto-generate thumbnails, extract EXIF, store dimensions, original filename, alt text, license/source
Quote assets: text, attributed_to, source_url, retrieved_at, license
Data table assets: csv upload → preview, column types, optional chart preview
Expert contact assets: name, expertise tags, email/contact, prior quotes given, response rate
Search across assets by tag, type, text
userStories.notes: License/source on every asset is non-negotiable for E-E-A-T and legal safety.

userStories.title: Audit log for every mutating action
userStories.description: As a workspace owner, I want a tamper-evident audit log so I can investigate incidents and prove compliance.
acceptanceCriteria: audit_log table: workspace_id, actor_user_id, action (string), target_type, target_id, before (jsonb), after (jsonb), ip, user_agent, created_at
Middleware logs every POST/PATCH/DELETE on the API
Admin UI: audit log viewer with filters (actor, action, date range)
Logs retained 1 year minimum; configurable
Append-only — no UPDATE or DELETE permission on audit_log via RLS
userStories.notes: Consider periodic export to immutable storage (S3 with object lock) for tamper-evidence.

userStories.title: Background job queue with retries and observability
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a reliable job system so AI calls, syndication, and analytics ingest can run async with backoff.
acceptanceCriteria: pg-boss (preferred — uses Postgres) or BullMQ adapter
Job types defined as TypeScript discriminated unions; handlers in apps/worker
Default policy: exponential backoff (1m, 5m, 30m, 2h), max 5 attempts
Job dashboard in admin UI: pending, active, failed, completed counts; retry / cancel buttons
Failed jobs surface in audit_log with full error stack
Idempotency keys on every job to prevent duplicate work
userStories.notes: pg-boss avoids a Redis dependency for small deployments.

userStories.title: Keyword research adapter interface + DataForSEO reference adapter
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want keyword data (volume, difficulty, CPC, trend) so I can prioritize topics with measurable demand.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/core/keyword-adapter.ts: searchVolume, keywordDifficulty, relatedKeywords, autocomplete, trend12mo
Adapters: dataforseo (reference), ahrefs, semrush, google-keyword-planner — all implementing the same interface
Workspace setting: which adapter + API credentials (encrypted)
Keyword cache table to avoid re-querying within TTL (default 30 days)
Bulk lookup endpoint: paste a list of seed keywords → returns enriched data
Cost tracking: every adapter call logs estimated cost in cents to ai_costs table
userStories.notes: Cost tracking matters — keyword APIs are metered and bills sneak up fast.

userStories.title: Search intent classifier
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want every keyword classified by intent so I plan the right content format.
acceptanceCriteria: Classifier tags each keyword: informational, commercial-investigation, transactional, navigational, with confidence score
Implementation: LLM prompt that takes keyword + top 10 SERP titles/snippets and returns intent + reasoning
Bulk classify on keyword import; cached on keywords.intent column
Admin UI: filter keyword list by intent; intent shown as colored chip
userStories.notes: Classification quality jumps dramatically when SERP context is included in the prompt.

userStories.title: SERP analyzer for any keyword
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want to see what currently ranks so I can match or exceed the bar.
acceptanceCriteria: SERP fetcher (DataForSEO or scraping adapter) returns top 20 organic results + SERP features (PAA, featured snippet, knowledge panel, video, image pack, local pack)
For each result: URL, title, meta description, domain, estimated DA, word count (fetched + parsed), heading structure (H2/H3)
Aggregated metrics: median word count, common headings, common entities, dominant content type (listicle/guide/comparison/etc.)
Stored in serp_snapshots table with fetched_at timestamp; re-fetch on demand or weekly
Admin UI: SERP analyzer view with sortable table + aggregate summary card
userStories.notes: Word count parsing must handle paywalls and JS-rendered content gracefully — fall back to meta description length when blocked.

userStories.title: People Also Ask + autocomplete miner
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want every related question surfaced so my content covers the actual user journey.
acceptanceCriteria: Recursive PAA crawler: fetch PAA for seed keyword, then for each PAA result, fetch its PAA (depth 2 default, configurable up to 4)
Google autocomplete fetcher: A-Z + 0-9 prefix expansion for seed keyword
Results stored in keywords table with source = 'paa' or 'autocomplete' and parent keyword reference
Deduplication and grouping by lexical similarity
Admin UI: tree view of PAA chains; click to add to brief
userStories.notes: Respect rate limits — back off aggressively on 429s.

userStories.title: Forum / community question miner (Reddit, Quora, Stack Exchange)
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want real questions from real users so my content addresses authentic pain rather than synthetic SEO phrases.
acceptanceCriteria: Reddit: search across configured subreddits via Reddit API; extract question titles + top comments
Quora: scrape (within ToS) or use Bright Data adapter for question + top answer snippets
Stack Exchange: API integration for relevant sites (StackOverflow, SuperUser, etc.)
Each question stored as a 'community_question' row with source, url, score/upvotes, captured_at
LLM clusters questions by theme; clusters surface in the brief generator
Configurable seed list per workspace (subreddits, Quora topics, SE sites)
userStories.notes: Always store source URL — citations from real questions strengthen E-E-A-T.

userStories.title: Competitor content gap analysis
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want to see keywords competitors rank for that we don't so I can prioritize quick wins.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace setting: competitor_domains (text[])
Job fetches each competitor's ranked keywords from the keyword adapter
Diff view: keywords competitors rank in top 10 for, where our domain ranks >20 or not at all
Filter by intent, volume, difficulty
One-click 'Create cluster from gap' adds the keyword group to keyword_clusters with source = 'gap_analysis'
Re-run on schedule (weekly default)
userStories.notes: Surface 'easy wins' first: keywords where competitors rank but their content is shallow.

userStories.title: Topic clustering with pillar-cluster model
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want keywords grouped into pillars and supporting clusters so my site builds topical authority deliberately.
acceptanceCriteria: Embedding-based clustering (OpenAI/Voyage embeddings) on keyword text + intent
Each cluster has: name (LLM-generated), pillar_keyword (highest volume + matches informational intent), supporting_keywords[], suggested_post_type per supporting keyword
Cluster visualizer: force-directed graph with pillar at center, supporting nodes connected, edge thickness = semantic similarity
Cluster status: planned, in-progress, published, decaying
Manual override: drag keyword between clusters or split/merge clusters
userStories.notes: Embeddings + a recluster job (weekly) keeps clusters fresh as new keywords arrive.

userStories.title: Internal link opportunity finder
userStories.description: As an editor, I want to know which existing posts should link to a new post (and vice versa) so internal linking happens by default rather than as an afterthought.
acceptanceCriteria: On post creation/update, embed full body and store in posts.embedding (pgvector)
Find candidate links: top-N posts by cosine similarity, filtered to same workspace
Suggest anchor text using LLM (extract phrase from source post matching target post's primary keyword)
Admin UI panel on post editor: 'Suggested internal links' with [Insert] buttons
Reverse view: for each existing post, suggest new content that should link back
One-click 'Backfill links' opens a PR-style review of all proposed link inserts before applying
userStories.notes: Anchor text variety matters — don't propose the same phrase 10 times.

userStories.title: Content decay detector
userStories.description: As a content manager, I want to be alerted when published posts lose rankings or traffic so I can refresh them before the decay accelerates.
acceptanceCriteria: Daily job pulls Search Console + GA4 metrics for every published post
Decay detection: 28-day rolling window vs prior 28-day window — flag if clicks down >20%, impressions down >25%, or position dropped >3
Decaying posts auto-add to refresh_queue with priority = severity
Admin UI dashboard: 'Decaying posts' card with sparkline per post
Email/Slack notification (configurable) when a post crosses decay threshold
userStories.notes: Tune thresholds per workspace — high-volume sites need different sensitivity than long-tail blogs.

userStories.title: Topical authority scorer per cluster
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want a single number per cluster that says how dominant we are so I can decide where to invest next.
acceptanceCriteria: Score formula combines: % of cluster keywords ranking top 10, % of cluster keywords with our content published, average rank across cluster, total cluster impressions captured
Score normalized 0-100 per cluster; recomputed daily
Admin UI: cluster heatmap (rows = clusters, color = authority score)
Trend line per cluster (90-day) so improvement is visible
API endpoint: GET /api/clusters/:id/authority returns full breakdown
userStories.notes: Authority is comparative — also surface 'authority vs top competitor' alongside the absolute score.

userStories.title: Auto-brief generator from keyword + SERP
userStories.description: As a writer, I want a thorough brief auto-generated so I can focus on writing instead of research compilation.
acceptanceCriteria: Input: target keyword (or cluster + pillar role) + workspace context

Brief sections: target keyword, secondary keywords, search intent, target audience persona, target word count (median of SERP +20%), target reading level, suggested H2/H3 outline (synthesized from top SERP), entities/NLP terms to include (extracted from top SERP via NER), FAQs (from PAA + community questions), schema markup plan, internal link opportunities, source list (top SERP + cited research), originality angle (what this post will say that nobody else does), CTA placement plan
Brief is editable Markdown; saved to briefs table with status = draft|approved|in-writing|done
Approve workflow: writer claims brief → status = in-writing; editor approval gate before status = approved
One-click 'Start writing' creates a post draft prefilled with brief outline as H2 placeholders
userStories.notes: The 'originality angle' field is what separates a great brief from a good one. Force the LLM to identify a contrarian or novel angle before writing.

userStories.title: Editorial calendar with assignments and deadlines
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a calendar view of upcoming and published content so the team has a shared schedule.
acceptanceCriteria: Calendar view (month/week) showing every post with status color-coded
Drag posts to reschedule publish_date; respects status (can't schedule a post still in 'idea' state)
Assignee per post (writer, reviewer); appears as avatar on the calendar tile
Filter by author, cluster, status
Export calendar to .ics so it shows up in Google Calendar / Outlook
Slack/Discord bot posts daily 'today's editorial' summary if integration enabled
userStories.notes: Drag-to-reschedule is the highest-ROI interaction; don't skimp on it.

userStories.title: Source aggregator with citation capture
userStories.description: As a writer, I want to capture and cite sources inline so the post is verifiable and E-E-A-T compliant.
acceptanceCriteria: Citation toolbar in editor: paste URL → fetcher pulls title, author, publish date, OG image, excerpt; saves to citations table
Inline reference: [^citation-id] syntax in markdown; rendered as superscript link
Citations panel on post editor: list, reorder, edit attribution
Auto-generate references section at post bottom on render
Schema.org Citation markup emitted for each reference
Browser extension (optional) sends current tab to the active draft as a citation
userStories.notes: Storing the excerpt + retrieved_at protects against link rot — you can show the original quote even if the source 404s later.

userStories.title: Reading-level and persona targeter
userStories.description: As an editor, I want every draft scored for reading level and audience match so we don't accidentally write for the wrong persona.
acceptanceCriteria: Flesch-Kincaid grade level computed live; shown as gauge in editor
Persona match score: LLM compares draft tone/vocabulary to brief's persona description; returns 0-100
Sentence-level highlighting: sentences above target grade level highlighted yellow, far above red
Suggestions: click highlighted sentence → 'Simplify' button replaces with LLM-rewritten version
Pre-publish gate: warns if persona match <70 or grade level diverges >2 from target
userStories.notes: Hemingway-style highlighting is well-loved for a reason — keep it visual and fast.

userStories.title: Schema markup planner and generator
userStories.description: As an SEO, I want every post to ship with appropriate JSON-LD so it's eligible for rich results and AI Overviews.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-post schema_type field: Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, HowTo, Recipe, Review, Product, FAQPage, Event
Generator builds JSON-LD from post fields + workspace's Organization data
FAQ blocks in editor auto-emit FAQPage schema
HowTo blocks (steps with images) auto-emit HowTo schema
Schema validator runs on save; blocks publish on errors (warnings allowed)
Preview pane shows the JSON-LD that will be emitted
userStories.notes: Don't fake aggregateRating or other reviewable signals — Google penalizes.

userStories.title: E-E-A-T plan: author bio, expertise, original research
userStories.description: As an editor, I want every post to have a credible author and original-data signal so we maximize E-E-A-T.
acceptanceCriteria: Authors table: name, slug, bio, headshot, credentials, expertise tags, social links, schema.org Person fields
Author page generated per author with all their posts + structured data
Per-post field: original_research_signal (enum: survey, internal-data, expert-interview, case-study, none) — 'none' triggers a soft warning
Author byline rendered with credentials inline
Reviewed-by field: optional second author who reviewed for accuracy
userStories.notes: The original_research_signal field is a forcing function — it surfaces shallow content during planning, not after publish.

userStories.title: Original data integration: surveys, internal data, public datasets
userStories.description: As a writer, I want to embed and chart original data so my post has unique value SEO can't easily commoditize.
acceptanceCriteria: Data sources: CSV upload, Google Sheets, internal Postgres views (via configured read-only credentials per workspace), public APIs
Chart builder: select dataset → choose chart type (bar/line/pie/scatter) → configure axes → embed as block in post
Charts render server-side to PNG (for AMP/email compatibility) AND client-side as interactive SVG
Data source URL stored as citation; alt text auto-generated from chart description
Re-render on data refresh (e.g., monthly survey) without changing post URL
userStories.notes: Recharts (interactive) + a server-side renderer like resvg or @napi-rs/canvas (static fallback) covers both needs.

userStories.title: Outline A/B variations scored against SERP
userStories.description: As an editor, I want multiple outline candidates so I can pick the strongest before committing a writer's time.
acceptanceCriteria: Brief generator produces 3 outline variants (different angles: how-to vs comparison vs deep-dive)
Each variant gets a predicted SERP-fit score (LLM compares variant to top SERP outlines)
Each variant gets a 'differentiation score' (how distinct from existing top SERP)
Editor picks one to proceed; rejected variants archived with brief for future reference
A/B test mode: write two posts on the same keyword cluster targeting different intents
userStories.notes: Differentiation score is more important than fit score after a topic is saturated.

userStories.title: AI draft generator with citations preserved inline
userStories.description: As a writer, I want a first draft generated from the brief that already cites its sources so I'm editing rather than from scratch.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator takes: approved brief + brand voice + style guide + author persona
Streams draft to editor section by section (H2 by H2) with progress indicator
Every factual claim must include an inline citation reference; if model can't ground a claim, it inserts [needs-citation] tag
Output structured: title, meta_title, meta_description, body (markdown with citation refs), suggested_image_prompts, faq_block
User can regenerate any section independently without re-running the whole draft
Token/cost logged per generation to ai_costs
userStories.notes: The [needs-citation] tag is a safety valve — better an honest gap than a hallucinated source.

userStories.title: Inline AI rewrite toolbar (shorter, longer, tone, simplify)
userStories.description: As a writer, I want quick AI assists on selected text so I can refine prose without leaving the editor.
acceptanceCriteria: Highlight any text → toolbar appears with: Shorten, Expand, Simplify, Make formal, Make casual, Add example, Add citation, Fix grammar
Each action sends the selection + workspace brand voice to LLM and replaces inline (with undo)
Custom prompt option: free-text instruction applied to selection
Diff view before applying: original vs proposed, accept/reject per-paragraph
userStories.notes: Per-paragraph diff acceptance prevents big regenerations from clobbering edits the writer just made.

userStories.title: SEO scoring engine with on-page checklist
userStories.description: As a writer, I want a live SEO score so I can hit on-page best practices without memorizing them.
acceptanceCriteria: Live checklist on editor sidebar with pass/warn/fail icons

Checks: target keyword in title, in H1, in first 100 words, in URL slug, density 0.5-2%, title length 50-60, meta description 140-160, H1 unique, alt text on every image, ≥1 internal link, ≥1 external link, all links not broken, schema markup valid, OG image set, canonical set
Total score 0-100; below 70 blocks publish (overrideable by editor+)
Per-check explanation on hover with 'why this matters' link to docs
userStories.notes: Don't be dogmatic about keyword density — flag extreme values (>3% or 0%) only.

userStories.title: Plagiarism and AI-content detection
userStories.description: As an editor, I want to verify originality before publish so we don't ship duplicate or detectable AI text.
acceptanceCriteria: Plagiarism check via Copyscape API (or Originality.ai) adapter; returns originality % + matched URLs
AI detection via Originality.ai or GPTZero adapter; returns AI-likelihood score
Pre-publish gate: configurable thresholds per workspace (default plagiarism <5%, AI-likelihood <50%)
Match URLs surfaced inline so writer can rephrase the matched section
Cost logged per scan
userStories.notes: AI detectors are imperfect — treat scores as advisory, don't hard-block on them.

userStories.title: Image generation and stock integration with auto alt text
userStories.description: As a writer, I want hero images and inline visuals without leaving the editor so visual content isn't a bottleneck.
acceptanceCriteria: Image generator adapters: DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Ideogram, Midjourney (via proxy)
Stock adapters: Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay (with attribution baked in)
Editor: 'Generate image' or 'Search stock' opens modal; insert chosen image into post
Auto-generated alt text via vision LLM; editable
Image optimization on upload: resize to multiple breakpoints (320, 768, 1200, 1920), generate WebP + AVIF, store originals separately
Hero/OG image required before publish
userStories.notes: Stock attribution must auto-render somewhere visible to comply with most stock licenses.

userStories.title: Meta title and description with CTR prediction
userStories.description: As an SEO, I want predicted CTR for title/meta variants so I can pick the strongest before publishing.
acceptanceCriteria: Generate 5 title + meta variants from post body via LLM
Score each variant: length compliance, keyword presence, emotional value (LLM rubric), question/number/bracket signals, predicted CTR (LLM heuristic + power words list)
SERP preview shows each variant as Google would render it
One-click pick + save
Post-publish: pull actual CTR from Search Console and feed back into the predictor over time
userStories.notes: Closing the feedback loop with real CTR data is what makes the predictor better than a generic LLM.

userStories.title: Inline fact-checker against captured sources
userStories.description: As an editor, I want every factual claim verified against the post's cited sources so we don't ship hallucinations.
acceptanceCriteria: On-demand 'Fact-check' button runs claim extraction across the draft
For each claim: identify supporting citation (or [needs-citation]), call LLM with claim + cited source excerpt, return verdict (supported / contradicts / not-found / needs-human)
Inline highlights with verdict color; click for explanation
Confidence score per verdict; <70% confidence flagged for human review
Batch fact-check runs server-side as a job for long posts
userStories.notes: False confidence is the failure mode — bias toward 'needs-human' when uncertain.

userStories.title: Diagram and chart generator from data
userStories.description: As a writer, I want to insert clean diagrams without leaving the editor so visuals enhance rather than slow me down.
acceptanceCriteria: Mermaid diagram block: live preview, syntax errors highlighted
Chart block (extends US-BLOG-029): pick from saved data assets or paste CSV inline
Excalidraw embed: open Excalidraw in modal, save SVG to assets, insert as image block
Each diagram stored in assets table with type='diagram' and source (mermaid_text, csv, or excalidraw_json) for editing later
Server-side renders all diagrams to PNG fallback for email/AMP
userStories.notes: Mermaid covers 80% of needs cheaply — Excalidraw is the escape hatch.

userStories.title: Self-critiquing agent loop for draft quality
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a draft that's been critiqued and revised by an AI critic before I see it so my time goes to high-value edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline: generator → critic (separate prompt with critique rubric) → reviser → critic → reviser, max 3 iterations
Critic rubric: clarity, originality, evidence, voice match, SEO compliance, factual grounding, structural balance
Each iteration recorded in post_revisions for transparency
Pipeline stops early if critic returns 'no significant issues'
User can view the critic's feedback log alongside the final draft
Per-workspace toggle: 'critique loop on/off' (it costs more tokens)
userStories.notes: The critic prompt is the highest-leverage piece — invest time tuning it per workspace.

userStories.title: Pre-publish QA pass: links, mobile preview, OG cards, accessibility
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a single QA panel that runs all pre-publish checks so nothing slips through.
acceptanceCriteria: Link checker: HEAD all internal + external links, flag 4xx/5xx/redirects
Mobile preview iframe at 375px width
OG/Twitter card preview as Slack, Twitter, LinkedIn, iMessage would render
Accessibility audit: axe-core run on rendered HTML; flag violations with severity
Schema validator (re-run from US-BLOG-027)
All checks must pass (or be explicitly overridden) before publish button enables
userStories.notes: Cache link-check results for 1h to avoid hammering the same URLs on every save.

userStories.title: Predicted ranking and traffic forecast pre-publish
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want a ranking and traffic forecast before publishing so I can decide if a post is worth shipping or needs more work.
acceptanceCriteria: Inputs: target keyword volume + difficulty, our domain authority, post quality score (composite of SEO/readability/originality), SERP competitiveness
Output: predicted rank range (e.g., 8-15), predicted clicks/month, confidence band
Comparison vs similar posts we've published (calibration over time)
Recommendation: 'publish now' / 'invest in originality' / 'build internal links first' / 'too competitive — pivot angle'
Stored on post; updated post-publish with actuals
userStories.notes: Predictions get reliable only after 50+ published posts feed the calibration model.

userStories.title: CMS publish flow via adapter
userStories.description: As an editor, I want one button to publish to our connected CMS so the blog system fits inside my existing site.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Publish' button respects status workflow: draft → in-review → approved → published
Calls cms-adapter.createPost or updatePost depending on whether external_id exists
Image assets uploaded to CMS first; URLs rewritten in body before post body is sent
Canonical URL stored in posts.canonical_url after publish
Failure surfaces inline with retry button; partial-publish state visible (e.g., images uploaded, post creation failed)
Webhook fires on successful publish for downstream consumers
userStories.notes: Idempotency on the adapter calls — retries shouldn't create duplicates.

userStories.title: Email newsletter generator from post
userStories.description: As an editor, I want an email version of every post auto-drafted so newsletter is part of the publish flow, not a separate effort.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator takes published post → produces: subject line variants (3), preheader, body (shorter than post: TLDR + 3-5 key points + CTA back to full post), plain-text fallback
Adapter pattern: ConvertKit, Mailchimp, Resend, Beehiiv, Substack — implementing send/schedule
Preview in inbox-style mockup
Schedule for date/time or send now
UTM params auto-applied to all links pointing back to the post
userStories.notes: Subject line and preheader carry 80% of open-rate weight — generate 3 variants and let the editor pick.

userStories.title: Per-platform syndication: X/Twitter thread generator
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want a Twitter thread tailored from each post so distribution is one click rather than a separate writing task.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator: hook (first tweet) optimized for engagement, 6-12 tweet thread, CTA tweet linking back to post, optional media slot (chart screenshot or hero image) per tweet
Per-tweet character count visible, auto-truncate with ellipsis warning
Brand voice + workspace X handle's recent style (if posts pulled in via API) factored into generation
Schedule via Twitter API or copy-to-clipboard fallback
Stored as a Distribution row with platform='x', status, scheduled_at, sent_at, post_url
userStories.notes: The hook (first tweet) is the only one most people read — generate 5 hook variants and let the user pick.

userStories.title: Per-platform syndication: LinkedIn long-form post
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want a LinkedIn-native version of each post that performs better than just a link share.
acceptanceCriteria: Generator: hook (first 2 lines visible before 'see more'), body 800-1500 chars (LinkedIn-optimal), bullet structure with line breaks, soft CTA, link in first comment (not in body)
Tone toggle: founder voice / company voice / thought leadership
Schedule via LinkedIn API or copy with explicit 'paste this in first comment' instruction for the link
Hashtag suggestions (3-5 relevant)
Distribution row tracks engagement post-publish
userStories.notes: LinkedIn deprioritizes posts with outbound links in body — link-in-comment is the workaround.

userStories.title: Per-platform syndication: Facebook + Instagram (post + carousel + Reel script)
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want Meta-platform variants without designing each one from scratch.
acceptanceCriteria: Facebook post: short copy + image + link
Instagram carousel: 6-10 slides with title + body per slide; image generation per slide (template-based, brand colors); export as PNG set
Instagram Reel script: hook (first 3 seconds), beat-by-beat 30s script, on-screen text, suggested b-roll, CTA
Schedule via Meta Graph API where available; manual export fallback
Distribution rows per platform
userStories.notes: Carousel templates should be configurable per workspace (brand colors, fonts, logo placement).

userStories.title: Per-platform syndication: TikTok / YouTube Shorts script
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want a short-video script with hook, beats, and on-screen text so any team member can record without writing scripts from scratch.
acceptanceCriteria: Script generator: hook (first 3 sec), 3-act structure (problem → insight → CTA), on-screen captions per beat, suggested camera angles, runtime target 30-60s
Trend-aware: optional flag pulls trending audio/format hashtags via TikTok/Apify adapter
Export as PDF storyboard
Track which posts have video variants in distributions
userStories.notes: Don't try to auto-generate the video itself for v1 — script + storyboard is high value, generation quality isn't there yet for brand work.

userStories.title: Per-platform syndication: Pinterest pins (multiple variations)
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want multiple Pinterest pin variants per post so I can A/B test designs that drive durable traffic.
acceptanceCriteria: Pin generator: 3-5 variants per post with different headlines, color schemes, layouts (text-heavy / image-heavy / quote-style)
Vertical 1000x1500 output; brand colors and fonts from workspace settings
Pin description auto-generated with target keyword and natural language
Schedule via Pinterest API; fallback to bulk PNG export
Distribution row per pin variant for performance comparison
userStories.notes: Pinterest is a long-tail traffic source — invest in templating early so pins are cheap to produce.

userStories.title: Per-platform syndication: Reddit-friendly version (rule-aware)
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want a Reddit version that respects each subreddit's rules so I can share without getting banned.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace setting: target subreddits with self-promotion ratio (e.g., 9:1) and rules summary
Generator produces: title (curiosity-driven, not clickbait), self-post body (value-first, link as secondary reference), or link-post format with comment-thread starter
Rule check: LLM compares draft against pasted-in rules per subreddit, flags violations
Self-promotion tracker: dashboard shows ratio of value posts to promo posts per subreddit
Manual post (no auto-submit) — copy to clipboard with 'Open subreddit' button
userStories.notes: Auto-posting to Reddit is a fast track to a shadowban — keep it copy-paste only.

userStories.title: Per-platform syndication: Hacker News, Medium, Substack
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want one-click syndication to long-form platforms with proper canonical handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Hacker News: title rewriter (no clickbait, declarative), submission timing recommender (peak HN hours), discussion-seed comment draft
Medium: full repost via Medium API with canonical_url set to original post URL; tags suggested
Substack: cross-publish to a connected Substack newsletter with canonical preserved
Distribution row per platform; surface engagement (HN upvotes, Medium claps, Substack opens) where APIs allow
userStories.notes: Canonical tag must point to the workspace's primary CMS URL or you'll cannibalize your own SEO.

userStories.title: Per-platform syndication: Slack / Discord community snippets
userStories.description: As a community manager, I want to share new posts in Slack/Discord with formatting that drives clicks rather than getting ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Slack snippet: rich attachment with title, image, 1-line summary, button-style CTA
Discord snippet: embed with same fields, role mention if configured
Per-channel templates (e.g., #general gets summary, #content gets full announcement)
Schedule via incoming webhooks; manual post fallback
Click-through tracked via UTM params
userStories.notes: One workspace can have multiple Slack/Discord targets — keep config plural from day one.

userStories.title: Auto-scheduling with optimal-time prediction per audience
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want each platform variant scheduled at the time most likely to perform so I'm not guessing.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-platform optimal-time model: pulls historical engagement from this workspace's distributions, finds best day-of-week × hour buckets
First-time platforms use industry defaults (configurable per workspace)
'Smart schedule' button picks the next optimal slot per platform
Conflict avoidance: don't schedule 2 posts on the same platform within 2h
Manual override always available
userStories.notes: Don't trust generic 'best time to post' charts — your audience's optimal times will diverge from averages.

userStories.title: UTM strategy and per-channel link tracking
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want consistent UTM params on every shared link so attribution works correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: UTM template per workspace: utm_source = platform, utm_medium = social/email/community, utm_campaign = post_slug
Every distribution row stores the UTM-tagged URL it sent
Bulk link-rewriter: paste post URL → returns tagged URL per platform
Short-link adapter (optional): Bitly, Rebrandly — for character-tight platforms
Verifier: GA4 integration confirms UTM-tagged sessions are arriving
userStories.notes: Lowercase everything in UTM values to avoid GA4 splitting Twitter and twitter into two sources.

userStories.title: Re-share cadence engine
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want each post to be re-shared on a schedule that surfaces value without spamming so evergreen content gets full lifetime traffic.
acceptanceCriteria: Default cadence: T+0 (publish day all platforms), T+3 (re-hook on X), T+7 (LinkedIn fresh angle), T+30 (community resurface), T+90, T+180
Each scheduled re-share generates a new variant (different hook) automatically
Stops auto-scheduling if engagement on prior re-shares is below threshold
Editor can pause/resume cadence per post
Distribution timeline view per post shows past + scheduled future shares
userStories.notes: Re-shares fail when they're identical to the original — variation is mandatory, not optional.

userStories.title: Internal-link auto-injection on publish
userStories.description: As an editor, I want existing posts auto-linked to a newly published pillar so internal linking compounds without manual backfill.
acceptanceCriteria: On publish of a post tagged as pillar, find top-N existing posts with high semantic similarity AND no link to the new pillar
Generate proposed anchor + sentence-level edits to insert the link naturally
Editor reviews proposed edits in PR-style diff view; accept all / reject all / per-change accept
Accepted edits create new revisions on those posts and re-publish via CMS adapter
Backlink count surfaced on the new pillar's stats card
userStories.notes: Keep human-in-the-loop on auto-injection — silent edits to published posts are a trust killer.

userStories.title: Backlink monitoring and lost-link recovery
userStories.description: As an SEO, I want to know when backlinks appear or disappear so I can capitalize on momentum and recover lost links.
acceptanceCriteria: Backlink adapter: Ahrefs, SEMrush, Majestic — implementing newBacklinks, lostBacklinks per domain
Daily job pulls deltas; new backlinks logged, lost backlinks added to recovery queue with last-seen URL
Recovery workflow: draft outreach email to the lost-link domain explaining the broken link and suggesting our updated URL
Notifications on high-DA new links (configurable threshold) so the marketing team can amplify
Backlink trend chart per post
userStories.notes: Lost-link recovery converts ~15-25% on a good day — well worth the automation.

userStories.title: Unlinked brand-mention monitor → outreach
userStories.description: As an SEO, I want unlinked mentions of our brand surfaced so I can convert them to backlinks.
acceptanceCriteria: Mention monitor: Google Alerts API alternative (Brand24, Mention.com, or scrape) — finds mentions of brand name across web
Filter: pages where brand is mentioned but no link to our domain
Per mention: propose outreach email contextualizing the mention and politely requesting a link
Outreach status tracker: sent, replied, link-added, declined, ghosted
Auto-detect when link is added (re-crawl mentioned URLs weekly) and update status
userStories.notes: Personalize the outreach with the actual mention quote — generic templates get ignored.

userStories.title: Outreach list generator (sites that linked to similar content)
userStories.description: As an SEO, I want a list of sites likely to link to my new post so outreach has high hit rates.
acceptanceCriteria: Input: published post + 3-5 similar competitor URLs
Pull backlink lists for competitor URLs via backlink adapter
Filter: high DA, content site (not directories), niche relevance score (LLM evaluates target site)
Find contact: hunter.io / clearbit / scrape contact pages
Output: prioritized outreach list with email, role, suggested angle per recipient
userStories.notes: Niche relevance score filter is what separates this from generic backlink scraping.

userStories.title: HARO / Help-A-B2B-Writer pitch generator
userStories.description: As a brand authority builder, I want to respond to HARO-style queries faster than the field so we get cited in major publications.
acceptanceCriteria: Inbound: HARO email parser (forward HARO emails to a workspace inbox; parse into queries)
For each query: match against author expertise tags, draft a pitch using author's bio + relevant past posts as evidence
Pitch format follows HARO conventions (bio, response, contact info)
Editor reviews pitch → approves → sends from workspace email
Track pitch status: sent, replied, included, ignored — feeds calibration of which queries are worth pursuing
userStories.notes: Speed wins HARO — be ready to send within 1h of the email landing.

userStories.title: Outreach agent: research + draft + track replies
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want an agent that handles the cold-email cycle so I'm reviewing relationships, not drafting templates.
acceptanceCriteria: Per outreach target: agent researches recipient (recent posts, social, mutual connections), drafts personalized email, queues for human approval
Approved emails sent via SMTP/SendGrid/Resend adapter from workspace domain
Reply detection via IMAP or webhook; agent classifies reply (interested / decline / question / out-of-office) and proposes next action
Cadence: follow-up 1 at +5d, follow-up 2 at +10d, then close as no-response
Engagement metrics per template/angle so the system learns what works
userStories.notes: Sending from a marketing subdomain (not the primary domain) protects deliverability if the cadence is too aggressive.

userStories.title: GA4 + Search Console integration
userStories.description: As an analyst, I want every post's performance pulled in automatically so I don't switch tabs to check numbers.
acceptanceCriteria: GA4 Data API: pull sessions, users, engagement_time, conversions per post URL daily
Search Console API: pull clicks, impressions, CTR, average position per post URL daily
Backfill 16 months on initial connect (Search Console max), 90 days for GA4
Per-workspace OAuth flow to connect properties
Metrics stored in performance_metrics table; surfaced on post detail page
Trend charts (28-day, 90-day, all-time) per post
userStories.notes: Search Console rate limits are tight — batch requests by date range, not by URL.

userStories.title: Performance dashboard: posts, clusters, channels
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a unified dashboard so I can answer 'how is content doing?' in one glance.
acceptanceCriteria: Top-level cards: total organic clicks (28d), top-performing posts, declining posts, conversions attributed
Per-cluster table: clicks, impressions, average position, # posts, authority score
Per-channel table (from distributions): clicks, sessions, conversions
Date range selector with comparison (vs prior period)
Export CSV per view
userStories.notes: Default the dashboard to 'last 28 days vs prior 28' — that's the comparison most editors want.

userStories.title: Content refresh queue with auto-flagged decay candidates
userStories.description: As a content manager, I want a prioritized refresh queue so the most decay-prone posts get attention first.
acceptanceCriteria: Queue auto-populated by US-BLOG-021 (decay detector) + manual additions
Each queue item: post, decay severity, suggested edits (LLM diffs current SERP vs current post), estimated effort
Click 'Start refresh' opens the post editor with suggested edits as inline annotations
Refresh updates posts.last_refreshed_at; tracked separately from publish_date
After refresh, monitor for ranking recovery; auto-close queue item on recovery
userStories.notes: Refreshing the title + intro + adding new sections recovers most decay; full rewrites are rarely needed.

userStories.title: A/B testing for titles, meta descriptions, CTAs
userStories.description: As an SEO, I want to test on-page elements so improvements are measured, not assumed.
acceptanceCriteria: Per-post experiments: variant A (current) vs variant B (proposed)
Title/meta tests: split-test by alternating variants weekly; compare CTR from Search Console
CTA tests: client-side variant assignment (cookie-based) with conversion tracking
Statistical significance calculator surfaces winner when n is sufficient
Winner auto-promoted (with editor approval) after threshold reached
userStories.notes: Search Console attribution lags 2-3 days — bake that into significance calc.

userStories.title: Cohort analysis: topic → revenue / signups
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want to know which topics drive business outcomes so investment shifts toward what works.
acceptanceCriteria: Conversion definition per workspace (signup, purchase, demo request) configured via GA4 conversion event
Attribution model: last-non-direct-click default; configurable to first-touch or linear
Cohort table: cluster → sessions → conversions → revenue (or signup count)
Time-to-conversion histogram per cluster
ROI per cluster: cost (writing + tools) vs revenue
userStories.notes: Most teams discover ~20% of clusters drive ~80% of revenue — cohort analysis makes the cut decision obvious.

userStories.title: Auto-refresh agent: SERP diff → proposed edits
userStories.description: As an editor, I want an agent that watches SERPs and proposes the smallest edit to recover rankings so refreshes are cheap.
acceptanceCriteria: Daily job: for posts in refresh_queue, re-fetch top SERP and diff vs the post's last SERP snapshot
Diff highlights: new entities competitors cover, new headings, new SERP features added since publish, new PAA questions
Agent generates a refresh proposal: minimal additions/edits to close the gap
Editor reviews proposal in diff view; accept inserts edits as a new revision
Auto-close refresh ticket once ranking recovers vs pre-refresh baseline
userStories.notes: Minimal edits beat full rewrites — the goal is rank recovery, not Pulitzer quality.

userStories.title: LLM citation graph analyzer (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews)
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want to know which of our posts get cited by AI systems and which competitor posts dominate the citation graph for our keywords.
acceptanceCriteria: Adapter pattern: chatgpt-search, perplexity, google-ai-overview probes — each takes a query, returns the cited URLs
For each tracked keyword cluster, run probes weekly; log citations to llm_citations table
Dashboard: 'AI citation share of voice' per cluster — % of probes citing our domain vs competitors
Diff view: queries where we appear in classic SERP top 10 but NOT in AI citations — hot opportunity list
Per-post AI citation count surfaced alongside organic metrics
userStories.notes: Probing has cost — sample queries, don't probe every keyword every day. Weekly per cluster is plenty.

userStories.title: Answer-Engine Optimization (AEO) chunk structuring
userStories.description: As an SEO, I want every post structured for LLM citation so AI engines can extract clean answers from our content.
acceptanceCriteria: Pre-publish AEO score: checks for self-contained paragraphs (each answers a discrete question), question-shaped H3s, explicit definitions, factual statements with dates and named entities, original-data callouts
Auto-suggest: rewrite vague paragraphs into self-contained answer chunks
Append a 'Quick answers' section at post top with bullet-form direct answers to top PAA questions
Schema.org QAPage / FAQPage applied to those sections
AEO score visible alongside SEO score
userStories.notes: AI Overviews citations correlate with self-contained, well-attributed paragraphs. Optimize for chunk-level quality, not just article-level.

userStories.title: Domain knowledge graph of entities and relationships
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want a knowledge graph of our domain so I can see entity coverage gaps and plan content accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: NER pipeline extracts entities (people, organizations, products, concepts, locations, dates) from every published post
Entities stored with type, frequency, first/last seen, related posts
Co-occurrence graph: entities mentioned together get edges weighted by co-mention frequency
Visualizer: force-directed graph with cluster-based coloring
Gap detector: entities competitors cover that we don't — added to keyword cluster planning
userStories.notes: Use a small NER model (spaCy or a fine-tuned small LLM) — calling GPT-4 for NER on every post is overkill and expensive.

userStories.title: Real-time SERP monitor with auto-refresh triggers
userStories.description: As an SEO, I want immediate alerts on SERP volatility for our top keywords so I can react before competitors capitalize.
acceptanceCriteria: Hourly SERP polling for tier-1 keywords (configurable list, default top 50 by traffic)
Volatility detection: rank change >3 positions, new SERP feature appearing, new competitor entering top 10
Alert channels: email, Slack, in-app notification — configurable per workspace
Auto-trigger: significant volatility on a published post adds it to refresh_queue with high priority
Volatility timeline per keyword for retrospective analysis
userStories.notes: Hourly polling is expensive — limit to tier-1 keywords. Daily for everything else.

userStories.title: Competitor publishing alerts with response brief
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want to be alerted when a key competitor publishes on a topic we own so I can respond fast.
acceptanceCriteria: Competitor RSS/sitemap monitoring per workspace (add competitor blog URLs)
New posts detected within 24h; LLM summarizes and tags with relevant keyword cluster
Alert if new competitor post targets a keyword we rank for
Auto-generate response brief: what they covered, what we should add or counter, suggested response post angle
One-click 'Create brief from response' adds to brief queue
userStories.notes: Most competitors update their sitemap.xml in real time — that's faster and lower-friction than scraping.

userStories.title: Audience-specific personalized variants from one master doc
userStories.description: As a strategist, I want one master article with multiple audience variants so we serve different ICPs without writing 3 articles.
acceptanceCriteria: Per post: define audience variants (e.g., 'engineer', 'manager', 'executive')
Each variant: different intro, different examples, different CTA, but shares the core body
Variant rendering: server-side personalization based on URL param, cookie segment, or referrer
Schema-aware: only one canonical URL; variants don't get separate URLs (avoid dup content)
Performance per variant tracked separately
userStories.notes: Server-side rendering with edge personalization (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel edge) is the right delivery mechanism. Don't index variant URLs.

userStories.title: Multi-agent draft pipeline: research → outline → draft → fact-check → critic → polish
userStories.description: As an editor, I want a chained agent pipeline that produces near-final drafts so human review focuses on judgment, not basics.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline stages as separate prompts/agents: researcher (gathers sources), outliner (structures from sources), drafter (writes from outline), fact-checker (verifies claims), critic (rubric-based critique), polisher (final pass)
Each stage's output stored as an artifact for transparency
Failures at any stage halt pipeline with explanation; resume from failed stage after fix
Cost + latency logged per stage
Per-workspace toggle: which stages to run (cost vs quality tradeoff)
userStories.notes: Pipeline output should always be reviewable as artifacts — opaque agent chains are debugging nightmares.

userStories.title: Programmatic SEO: templated pages from data
userStories.description: As a growth marketer, I want to generate hundreds of templated pages from a dataset so we capture long-tail traffic systematically.
acceptanceCriteria: Template engine: Markdown template with {{variables}}; data source = CSV upload, Google Sheet, internal Postgres view
Variables: any field from data row (e.g., {{city}}, {{product}}, {{stat}})
Per-template: SEO config (title pattern, meta pattern, schema type), brand voice, output destination (CMS adapter)
Quality gate: template + data row run through SEO scorer; rows scoring <70 flagged for manual review or skipped
Bulk publish job with rate limiting (e.g., 50/hour) to avoid CMS overload
Bulk update / unpublish workflows when data changes
userStories.notes: Programmatic SEO without quality gates = doorway pages = manual penalty. Always gate on uniqueness + value per page.

userStories.title: Interactive content blocks: calculators, quizzes, tools
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want to embed interactive tools in posts so we generate utility-driven backlinks.
acceptanceCriteria: Block types: calculator (formula + input fields → output), quiz (question + answer scoring → result), comparison tool, ROI estimator
No-code builder: drag inputs, define formula, configure result text
Embedded as iframe (or inline component if same domain) with tracking
Lead capture (optional): email gate before showing result
Engagement metrics: completion rate, share rate, conversion rate per tool
userStories.notes: Calculators are the highest-ROI interactive content for B2B — they earn backlinks for years.

userStories.title: Multimodal output: podcast TTS + video script + social clips
userStories.description: As a marketer, I want every post repurposed into audio/video automatically so content reaches non-readers.
acceptanceCriteria: Podcast: ElevenLabs/PlayHT TTS adapter; full post narrated with brand voice clone (if licensed); chapter markers from H2s
Output to MP3 + RSS feed (per workspace) for podcast distribution
Video script: structured beats from post; integrate with HeyGen/Synthesia adapter for avatar video (optional)
Social clips: 30-60s audio clips of key insights for IG audiograms / LinkedIn audio posts
Each output stored as asset linked to source post
userStories.notes: Voice cloning requires explicit consent + license — gate behind a 'voice license uploaded' flag per author.

userStories.title: Localization and translation pipeline
userStories.description: As an international team, I want every post translatable into target locales with proper SEO so we capture global search.
acceptanceCriteria: Locale enum per workspace (e.g., en-US, es-MX, de-DE)
Translation adapter: DeepL, Google Translate, GPT-4 — implementing translate(text, source, target, glossary)
Per-locale brand voice variant (different tone for different markets)
Glossary: workspace-specific terms not to translate (brand names, product names)
Hreflang tags emitted on every post; sitemap split per locale
Locale-specific publish flow: each translation has its own status, reviewer, publish_date
userStories.notes: Don't auto-publish translations without native review — machine translation is good for v1 drafts, never for ship.

userStories.title: AI cost dashboard with per-workspace quotas
userStories.description: As a platform operator, I want full visibility into AI spend per workspace so I can bill / cap accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Every adapter call logs to ai_costs: workspace_id, provider, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cost_cents, request_id, feature (which feature called it)
Dashboard: cost by workspace, by feature, by model — daily / monthly views
Per-workspace monthly quota; warn at 80%, hard-stop at 100% (overrideable)
Forecasted spend based on rolling 7-day average
Alerts: anomaly detection (sudden 3x spike) → email/Slack
userStories.notes: Anomaly detection catches infinite-loop bugs and rogue jobs before they consume the monthly budget.

userStories.title: Webhook event bus for downstream consumers
userStories.description: As a developer integrating the blog system, I want webhook events for every meaningful state change so I can sync with external systems.
acceptanceCriteria: Events: post.created, post.updated, post.published, post.refreshed, distribution.sent, distribution.failed, brief.approved, refresh_queue.added
Per-workspace webhook config: URL, secret (HMAC signing), event filter, retry policy
Delivery: at-least-once with exponential backoff, dead-letter queue after max attempts
Webhook log viewer: payload, response, timestamp, attempt count
HMAC signature verification documented for consumers
userStories.notes: Always sign webhook payloads — unsigned webhooks are an attack surface.

userStories.title: Public REST API with OpenAPI spec and SDK
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a clean public API so I can build custom workflows and integrations on top of the blog system.
acceptanceCriteria: OpenAPI 3.1 spec auto-generated from route handlers (zod-to-openapi or similar)
Endpoints for every domain object: keywords, briefs, posts, distributions, performance
Auth: API keys per workspace with scoped permissions
Rate limits per API key; documented
Generated TypeScript SDK published to npm; Python SDK as stretch
API docs site (Scalar / Redocly) auto-deployed
userStories.notes: OpenAPI-first means SDKs and docs stay in sync — never hand-write either.

userStories.title: Backup, export, and import per workspace
userStories.description: As a workspace owner, I want full data portability so I can back up, migrate, or comply with deletion requests.
acceptanceCriteria: Export: full workspace data as ZIP (posts as Markdown + frontmatter, assets as files, briefs as Markdown, settings as JSON)
Import: ZIP from another workspace replays into target workspace; collision resolution (skip / overwrite / suffix)
Scheduled backups: daily ZIP to S3-compatible storage per workspace
Retention: 30 days default, configurable
Right-to-delete: full workspace purge job (audit_log preserved with anonymized actor IDs)
userStories.notes: Markdown + frontmatter as the canonical export means consumers can fork to any system without lock-in.

userStories.title: Onboarding checklist and demo workspace seed
userStories.description: As a new workspace owner, I want a guided setup so I'm productive in 30 minutes rather than 3 days.
acceptanceCriteria: Onboarding checklist: connect CMS, set brand voice, connect GA4 + Search Console, connect keyword adapter, connect at least one social platform, write first brief
Demo workspace template: pre-seeded brand voice, sample posts, sample brief — clonable in one click
Tooltips on first-visit per major feature
Progress bar shows % complete; nudges at 1d / 3d / 7d if incomplete
Time-to-first-publish tracked as activation metric
userStories.notes: Time-to-first-publish is the single best activation metric — optimize for it ruthlessly.

userStories.title: Embeddable widget: 'Powered by Blog System' for white-label use
userStories.description: As a host product (Daily OK, etc.), I want to embed the blog admin UI inside my own admin so editors don't context-switch.
acceptanceCriteria: Iframe-able admin UI with postMessage bridge for auth
White-label config: hide 'Blog System' branding, set workspace logo + colors
Single sign-on: parent app issues a signed token; blog system trusts it for the duration
Theming inherits from parent (CSS variables exposed)
Documentation for host app integration
userStories.notes: This is what makes the system reusable across your platforms — without it, every host needs to swap in its own admin.

userStories.title: Compliance: GDPR, CCPA, SOC2-friendly logging
userStories.description: As a platform operator, I want compliance-ready primitives so the system can serve enterprise customers.
acceptanceCriteria: PII inventory: which tables hold PII, what fields, retention policy
Data subject access: export all data for a given user (across workspaces they're a member of)
Right to erasure: anonymize user data while preserving aggregate metrics
Audit log immutability (from US-BLOG-011) and encryption at rest
Data processing addendum (DPA) template
Security overview doc for prospects
userStories.notes: Don't promise SOC2 without an actual audit — but build the foundations now so the audit is cheap later.

userStories.title: End-to-end smoke test: idea → published → distributed → measured
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a single test that exercises the whole pipeline so regressions are caught before they ship.
acceptanceCriteria: E2E test: create workspace → run keyword research → generate brief → generate draft → run QA → publish to test CMS → syndicate to 2 mock platforms → ingest mock metrics
Runs against ephemeral test database + mocked external adapters
Total runtime <5 minutes
CI gate: PRs blocked if E2E fails
Failure mode: each stage screenshots / logs artifact for debugging
userStories.notes: This is the single highest-value test in the system — it catches integration regressions that unit tests miss.
